summary:
*Fleetwood Mac* is the band’s 1975 tenth studio album and the first to feature Lindsey Buckingham and Stevie Nicks. Their arrival, after Bob Welch left, began the band’s most successful lineup.

Released in the United States and United Kingdom by Reprise Records, the album was recorded in early 1975 and produced by Keith Olsen and the band. It combined songs the new members had written before joining with new work by Christine McVie.

The album reached number one on the US Billboard 200 in 1976 and produced three US top-20 singles: “Over My Head,” “Rhiannon,” and “Say You Love Me.” It also included “Landslide.” In the UK, it peaked at number 23. The album has sold over nine million copies in the United States and was certified gold in the UK.

Its success established the new lineup and began a run of major Fleetwood Mac albums, including *Rumours*.
